We are pleased to hear your positive comments regarding our clinical staff and would like to address the concerns you have raised regarding practice management.

As an external commentator, you would not be expected to be familiar with the internal contractual, regulatory, and commissioning requirements under which NHS GP practices operate. For that reason, we are unable to agree with the conclusions you have drawn regarding NHS funding or practice decision-making.
